cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take you through the crash in order. You asked whether the roads were wet: they were.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked whether you were driving too fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll get there. Do you want me to write it down? The rain started before I left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Write your speed. That's what the insurer needs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put the time beside it too. On your first question: heavy rain from six until eight.

reason: Make A lead an accident report and accept written detail to keep B cooperating, while still sincerely supplying the earlier weather answer.
